resources.string: Zero Reel watches supported apps and backs you out of Shorts, Reels, TikTok, Facebook Reels, and Spotlight. It does not read passwords or send data off the phone.
Zero Reel uses device admin only so Android asks you to deactivate it before uninstall. Deactivate it from the app with your authenticator code. This does not hide the app or wipe the phone.
Zero Reel protection is on. Disarm it from the Zero Reel app with your authenticator code before removing uninstall protection.
Shows that Zero Reel is still running after restart
Blocking Reels after restart. Authenticator required to stop.

Regular device admin only adds an extra Settings tap. Strict lock uses Android Device Owner so the Uninstall button is disabled until you disarm with an authenticator code.

On a computer with USB debugging:
1. Install Zero Reel and finish setup.
2. If the command fails, remove Google accounts from the phone first (or use a test phone).
3. Run this command:

adb shell dpm set-device-owner com.zeroreel.app/.ZeroReelAdminReceiver

Then open Zero Reel and tap Apply strict lock.

Factory reset can still wipe the phone. That is Android's last-resort escape, not a hidden backdoor.
